Happy Feet Luxury Vinyl Flooring

Happy feet. Happy floors. Happy home.

Happy Feet offers a wide variety of value-priced luxury vinyl flooring collections that are perfect for residential and commercial spaces alike. Currently warehousing over 16 million square feet of contemporary and traditional-styled luxury vinyl floors in stock and ready to ship, Happy Feet, International is an industry force and leader for years to come.

Available in PVC Glue Down, LVT PVC Click Lock, PVC Loose Lay, WPC, and SPC Rigid Core construction options, there is certain to be a floor to fit your busy lifestyle's needs. Each of these floors comes with an impressive limited residential | light commercial | limited commercial warranty, offering customers peace of mind and confidence.

Happy Feet luxury vinyl floors are constructed in a variety of plank widths, thicknesses, lengths, wear layers, and textures. For full specifications and color options, click any of the collection links above to learn more.
